file_manager.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete
file_manager.description: Create, delete, move, copy files and folders
file_manager.name: Name
file_manager.title: File Manager

fm.browse.binary_no_preview: This is a binary file, so there is nothing to preview.
fm.browse.dir_size_hint: Measuring a folder means reading every file inside it, so it is not done automatically. Run a storage analysis to get the real number.
fm.cat.duplicates.desc: Files with the same size and the same SHA-256 checksum. One copy of every group is always kept. Identical does not mean redundant, so open each group and look at where the copies live before deleting.
fm.cat.duplicates.label: Duplicate files
fm.cat.empty_dirs.desc: Folders with nothing left inside. They are removed from the deepest one upwards, so a parent that only just became empty goes too.
fm.cat.empty_dirs.label: Empty folders
fm.cat.node_modules.desc: Installed npm packages. Getting them back needs npm and a working internet connection, and a project with no lock file may not come back exactly the same.
fm.cat.node_modules.label: node_modules folders
fm.cat.old_logs.desc: Log files older than 30 days that sit in a real log folder. Database write-ahead logs (LevelDB and RocksDB) are excluded — they are named .log but they are your data, and deleting them corrupts the store.
fm.cat.old_logs.label: Old log files
fm.cat.os_junk.desc: Thumbs.db, .DS_Store and ._ sidecar files. desktop.ini is included but marked for review, because it stores a folder's icon and display name rather than being junk.
fm.cat.os_junk.label: Operating system junk
fm.cat.pkg_cache.desc: Downloaded package archives kept around to speed up reinstalls. They are downloaded again when they are needed.
fm.cat.pkg_cache.label: pip and npm caches
fm.cat.pycache.desc: Compiled .pyc files that Python writes again the next time it runs the same code. Safe, but usually a small win.
fm.cat.pycache.label: Python bytecode cache (__pycache__)
fm.cat.temp_files.desc: .tmp, .temp, .part and .crdownload files that nothing has touched for at least a day. A download still in progress is left alone.
fm.cat.temp_files.label: Temporary and unfinished downloads
fm.cat.venv_build.desc: Build, dist and wheel leftovers inside Python virtual environments. The environment that is currently running TubeCLI is never offered.
fm.cat.venv_build.label: Virtual environment build leftovers
fm.clean.dry_run_note: The preview runs the exact same plan as the real delete and stops one step short of it, so what you see here is what will happen.
fm.clean.excluded_desc: Git repositories, database files, credential files, virtual environments, the target of any junction or symbolic link, and anything outside your allowed folders are excluded from every category.
fm.clean.failed_hint: Every failure below names the file and the reason it could not be deleted. Nothing was skipped quietly.
fm.clean.freed_note: Freed counts only files that really disappeared, measured at the moment each one was deleted.
fm.clean.no_selection: Pick at least one category first.
fm.clean.nothing: There is nothing to clean in this folder.
fm.clean.scan_hint: Only the folders you are allowed to open are scanned. Git repositories, databases, credential files and virtual environments are never offered.
fm.clean.subtitle: Find files that can be recreated and get the space back
fm.clean.title: Cleanup
fm.cleanup_confirm_body: This deletes {n} items from the groups: {cats}. It frees about {b}. There is NO undo and no recycle bin.
fm.cleanup_confirm_hint: Type {word} below to unlock the delete button.
fm.cleanup_confirm_review: This includes a "needs review" group — make sure you read the list above.
fm.cleanup_divergence: Warning: the result differs from the preview — preview listed {p} items, the real run handled {a}. The tree changed between the two.
fm.cleanup_dryrun_flag: The server says this was still a dry run (dry_run=true), so NOTHING was deleted.
fm.cleanup_dryrun_ignored: The server returned dry_run=false for a preview request. The items below MAY have been deleted for real — check the folder before doing anything else.
fm.cleanup_preview_empty: The preview contains no items to delete.
fm.cleanup_scanning: Searching… ({t}). Large folders can take minutes.
fm.clip_copy: Will copy: {name} — go to the destination folder and press Paste.
fm.clip_cut: Will move: {name} — go to the destination folder and press Paste.
fm.clipboard_unavailable: The browser only allows clipboard access over HTTPS or localhost.
fm.common.copy_failed: The clipboard is not available on this page. Select the path and copy it by hand.
fm.common.name: Name
fm.confirm.cleanup_body: You are leaving preview mode. The files are removed straight away and cannot be recovered.
fm.confirm.cleanup_mismatch: The word does not match, so nothing was deleted.
fm.confirm.delete_body: This cannot be undone. There is no recycle bin here.
fm.confirm.delete_folder_body: The folder and everything inside it will be removed. This cannot be undone, and there is no recycle bin here.
fm.confirm.perm_body: This touches every file and folder underneath. Each failure is reported separately, and nothing is rolled back afterwards.
fm.confirm.stop_scan: Stop the analysis? The partial results stay on screen.
fm.disk.label: Label
fm.disk.skipped_pseudo: Virtual file systems (tmpfs, devfs, overlay) and repeated mounts of the same device are left out — they are not real storage.
fm.disk.subtitle: How much space is left on each mounted volume
fm.disk.title: Drives
fm.disk.unreadable: This volume did not answer. It may be disconnected, or it may need a permission this service does not have.
fm.drive.confirm_trash: Move "{name}" to the Drive trash? (recoverable for 30 days)
fm.drive.no_accounts: No Google account has authorized Drive yet
fm.drive.no_accounts_hint: Open Auth Manager, click Authorize and pick the Google Drive scope. Come back here and hit Refresh.
fm.drive.no_accounts_rail: No Drive account yet — authorize in Auth Manager.
fm.drive.share_anyone: Public sharing enabled — the link was copied to your clipboard.
fm.drive.share_anyone_link: Public sharing enabled. Copy the link: {url}
fm.drive.share_choice: Enter an email to share privately, or leave empty for a public link (anyone with the link can view):
fm.drive.subtitle: Browse, upload, rename and share Google Drive files with the accounts authorized in Auth Manager
fm.err.exists: {name} already exists here. Choose a different name.
fm.err.forbidden: That path is outside the folders this page is allowed to open.
fm.err.in_use: {path} is open in another program, so Windows will not delete it. Close that program and try again.
fm.err.network: TubeCLI cannot be reached. Check that the server is still running, then try again.
fm.err.no_disk_info: The volume list could not be read: {message}
fm.err.not_found: {path} does not exist any more. It may have been moved or deleted since the last refresh.
fm.err.path_too_long: This system will not accept a path this long: {path}
fm.err.permission: The operating system refused access to {path}.
fm.err.read_only: {path} is marked read-only, so it was not deleted. Clear the read-only flag first if you really want it gone.
fm.err.scan_failed: The analysis stopped with an error: {message}
fm.err.timeout: The request took too long. The job may still be running on the server — refresh to check.
fm.err.unlink_open_posix: {path} was unlinked while a program still had it open. The space will only come back once that program closes the file, so it is not counted as freed.
fm.err.walk_partial: {n} folders could not be read and are not included in these numbers.
fm.err_aborted: Request stopped at your request. The server may still be working.
fm.err_network: Could not reach the server ({url}). Check that the TubeCLI API is still running.
fm.err_no_api: File Manager API not found. Tried: {tried}. The server is up but serves none of those.
fm.err_shape: The server replied successfully but the "{field}" field is missing. Got: {got}
fm.media.cannot_play: This browser cannot play {ext} files. Download the file and open it in another player.
fm.media.load_failed: The file could not be loaded. It may have been moved or deleted since the last refresh.
fm.name_invalid: The name cannot contain "/" or "\", and cannot be "." or "..".
fm.nav.subtitle: Browse your files, find out where the space went, and clean up safely
fm.nav.title: File Manager
fm.paste_same_dir: Source and destination are the same folder — nothing to do.
fm.perm.acl_present: This item also carries an ACL, which overrides the mode shown here. The mode alone is not the whole story.
fm.perm.acl_unknown: ACLs could not be checked because the getfacl tool is not installed, so the mode shown here may not be the effective permission.
fm.perm.method_note: These three answers come from actually trying the operation, not from asking the system for a prediction.
fm.perm.partial: Some items could not be changed. Nothing was skipped quietly — every failure is listed below.
fm.perm.recursive_note: Folders get the matching enter bit added, otherwise the whole subtree becomes unreachable — including for the operation that would undo this.
fm.perm.recursive_refuse: A recursive mode with no owner-execute bit would lock you out of the folder. Change the mode or turn off the recursive option.
fm.perm.root_note: TubeCLI is running as root. Root ignores these permissions, so "readable" and "writable" describe root and not the person who will actually open the file.
fm.perm.special_note: The leading octal digit holds setuid, setgid and the sticky bit. It is kept when you change the mode, never dropped.
fm.perm.subtitle: Who is allowed to read, write and run this item
fm.perm.symlink_note: This is a symbolic link. The permissions shown belong to the link itself, not to whatever it points at.
fm.perm.title: Permissions
fm.perm.unknown_owner: The system has no name for this ID, so the number is shown instead.
fm.perm.walk_error: This folder could not be read while walking the tree, so what is inside it was never visited: {error}
fm.perm.win_empty_dacl: The access control list exists but is empty, so nobody is granted anything.
fm.perm.win_exec_note: Executable is decided from the file extension against PATHEXT, because Windows has no execute bit.
fm.perm.win_no_posix: Windows does not store a POSIX mode. Showing one here would be inventing a fact the system never recorded.
fm.perm.win_no_write: Editing Windows permissions from this page is switched off on purpose. One wrong deny entry can lock you out of your own folder for good, and undoing it needs an administrator shell that this service does not have.
fm.perm.win_null_dacl: This item has no access control list at all. On Windows that means everyone has full access — it is not the same as an empty list.
fm.perm.win_read_only_ui: Windows permissions are shown for reading only.
fm.perm.win_skipped_ace: {n} entries use a type this page cannot read and are not shown. The list below is therefore incomplete.
fm.perm_effective: Actual for the running process: read {r} · write {w} · execute {x}
fm.perm_invalid_mode: Invalid mode. Enter 3 or 4 octal digits, e.g. 755 or 0644.
fm.perm_recursive_warn_body: Mode {mode} has no execute bit for the owner. Applying it recursively makes the subfolders impossible to enter — including to undo this. The server may refuse. Send anyway?
fm.perm_recursive_warn_title: This mode will lock the subfolders
fm.perm_special_bits: The current mode carries special bits ({bits}). They are preserved; the checkboxes below only edit the 9 ordinary permission bits.
fm.perm_win_no_entries: The server returned an empty ACE list. This does NOT mean nobody has access — reading the DACL most likely failed.
fm.perm_win_readonly: On Windows this page reads permissions but does not edit them. A misplaced deny ACE can lock a folder permanently in a way only an elevated account can undo — which a background service does not have.
fm.picker.hint: File picker mode — click to select, double-click to confirm.
fm.risk.review_desc: Only you can decide about these. Read the examples before you delete anything here.
fm.risk.safe_desc: These are rebuilt automatically the next time they are needed. Deleting them costs nothing but a little time.
fm.scan_poll_failed: Lost contact with the scan job after {n} attempts: {msg}
fm.scan_stalled: No change for {s} seconds — most likely inside a very large folder.
fm.search_capped: The server caps results at 200 — there may be more.
fm.usage.cancelled_msg: The analysis was stopped, so the numbers below cover only the part that was read.
fm.usage.expired: That analysis is no longer on the server. Start a new one.
fm.usage.links_note: Junctions and symbolic links are not followed, so no file is counted twice.
fm.usage.long_hint: A big folder tree can take several minutes. You can keep working elsewhere and come back, or stop it at any point.
fm.usage.no_children: There are no sub-folders with anything in them.
fm.usage.partial_warning: Some folders could not be read, so they are missing from these totals. They are listed below.
fm.usage.progress_note: Progress counts files, not bytes, so it may move in jumps.
fm.usage.subtitle: Walk through a folder to see exactly what is using the space
fm.usage.title: Storage analysis
fm.vol_failed: Could not read the volume list: {msg}
fm.vol_outside: This volume is outside the allowed roots, so it cannot be opened here.
